title: Broome County Sheriff's Office Featured Warrant: Jennifer Stokes - NewsBreak
text:
By Courtney Carr No media credit provided. ,
7 hours ago
BROOME COUNTY, N.Y. (WIVT/WBGH) – The Broome County Sheriff’s Office is searching for Jennifer Stokes, who is wanted on an outstanding warrant.
On February 4th, the BCSO released a press release regarding the search of Jennifer Stokes. According to police Stokes is wanted on a Petit Larceny Warrant, a NYS Parole Violation, and 4 additional warrants out of Broome County.
Stokes is described as a white female, standing five feet two inches, red hair with blue eyes.
The BC Sheriff’s Office asks any individual with knowledge of the whereabouts of Stokes to please contact the office’s tip line at (607) 778-1196. Electronic tips can be submitted to the BCSO website, https://gobroomecounty.com/sheriff/warrants .
